summary: A squid forward proxy can serve as the HTTP/HTTPS proxy backend; open the AAP control plane ports in squid (Safe_ports 81, 82, 389, 444, 445 and SSL_ports 22, plus 444, 445, 8443-8446, 44321, 44322 for containerized installs).
questions: Which ports must I open on squid for Ansible Automation Platform?
squid acl Safe_ports for AAP containerized install
Can I use squid as the proxy for AAP?
AAP traffic blocked by squid http_access deny CONNECT

answer_card.title: Squid ports for AAP
answer_card.answer_md:
Allow AAP ports in `squid.conf`:
```
acl Safe_ports port 81
acl Safe_ports port 82
acl Safe_ports port 389
acl Safe_ports port 444
acl Safe_ports port 445
acl SSL_ports port 22
```
Containerized installs also need `SSL_ports` 444, 445, 8443, 8444, 8445, 8446, 44321, 44322, then:
```
http_access deny !Safe_ports
http_access deny CONNECT !SSL_ports
```
